0.EN:
So you're the one kidnapping children around town!
As long as a demon like you is still around...
I will be reborn in... a few years, give or take!

1.EN:
You're operating on the children to turn them into monsters
and make them work for you...?! Unforgivable!
Come to me, Labor Sector!

2.EN:
Snap out of it, Nomihiko! I don't want to fight you...
...At least, I think that's how I felt 10 years ago!

3.EN:
1.21 jigabytes, gone?! Just like that?! Even though it's made in Japan?!
Whoa, this is heavy...

4.EN: Next Saturday night, we're sending you back... to the office!

5.EN: See you in about 30 years! ...I'll be waiting with a backup of the data!

6.EN: Calm down. It's time to clock out, let's go home.

7.EN:
What is America planning to do with Gojida?
Does this count as leaving on time? Or will it affect my assessment?

8.EN:
The success of our nation is built upon "scrap and build" and "leave on the dot."
It's time to wrap up for the day.

9.EN:
If you're gonna chicken out, then don't push yourself.
But if you've already gotten your spoon, you'd better dig in.
If you bring one plate to the door... you're a Potluck-Venger!

10.EN:
I'd eat it all on my own if I had to.
But I know I don't have to do this alone!

12.EN:
I'm not afraid of anything anymore...
Because I'm not the only one who's been turned into a machine!

13.EN:
I just don't get it.
Why are humans so touchy about whether they have a heart or a brain?

14.EN:
I don't care... because if it's for you,
I'll stay trapped in this digital maze... forever.

15.EN:
If someone with a body like mine can really warm the hearts of other people...
I think that'd be really nice.

16.EN: I want to play it... I want to learn how to play "I Love You"!

17.EN:
An optimal Auto Musical Doll must be able to decipher
the true feelings in a piece and express them through music.
You were able to express a feeling.

18.EN:
What you've done will never be forgotten...
But the music you play will never fade from the hearts of your audience either.

19.EN:
People all have a melody in their hearts that they want others to hear...
There's no such thing as a melody that doesn't deserve to be played, Miss.

20.EN:
Leave Grandpa's door to me...
I'll be the one to open it for him.

21.EN: You... You never had the key to your house in your bag to begin with?!

22.EN: Who says a spare key can't rival the original?

23.EN:
And that is why, King of Heroes...
You've lost the key to your own house!

24.EN:
Everyone who lived in this house, and everyone connected to them,
has either died or gone missing... and for some strange reason,
every single one of them disappeared on their birthday.

25.EN: Hey, there's a haunted house around here! Wanna go check it out?

26.EN:
The owner, Takeo Sasaki, killed his wife Karako in their own house.
The same man was later discovered dead in the streets,
and is said to have died while eating his son's birthday cake.

27.EN: No... No, stop, get away from me...! AAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!

29.EN:
Did you trip over your own feet again?
Can't you even escort your own little sister properly?
You're such a pathetic older brother. Stuuupid!

30.EN:
Kirina-chan, don't say that. Your brother did his best!
Here, are you all right? Does it hurt? I'll kiss your boo-boo so it gets better.

31.EN:
Coco! Stop spoiling my brother!
Helping a loser like him is just a waste of time!
